classification.difficultyReason: Coordinate three half-planes, calculate boundary intersections using substitution or simultaneous equations and label the resulting triangular region. Strict systems also require excluding every boundary and vertex; the stated triangular outcome guides the construction.

content.prompt: Sketch the following systems of inequalities on the same axes. Show the intersecting region and label the points of intersection. The result should be a triangle in each case.

answer.short: Triangle with vertices $(0,0)$, $(0,1)$ and $(2,0)$, including all boundaries.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}3x+6y&\le 6\\6y&\le -3x+6\\y&\le -\frac12x+1\end{aligned}$$
The sloping boundary has intercepts $(0,1)$ and $(2,0)$. Draw all three boundaries solid. Shade the region to the right of the $y$-axis, above the $x$-axis and below the sloping line. The vertices are $(0,0)$, $(0,1)$ and $(2,0)$.

spec.description: Arrowed axes without numbered ticks; three solid boundaries, labelled intersections and a shaded required triangle. The origin O is omitted under the house graph convention.

answer.short: Triangle with vertices $(0,0)$, $(0,-4)$ and $(2,0)$, including all boundaries.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}2x-y&\le4\\-y&\le4-2x\\y&\ge2x-4\end{aligned}$$
The inequality reverses when dividing by $-1$. The sloping boundary has intercepts $(0,-4)$ and $(2,0)$. Draw all boundaries solid. Shade to the right of the $y$-axis, below the $x$-axis and above the sloping line. The vertices are $(0,0)$, $(0,-4)$ and $(2,0)$.

spec.description: Arrowed axes without numbered ticks; solid ascending boundary and required triangular region below the x-axis and right of the y-axis, with labelled intersections.

answer.short: Triangle with vertices $(0,15)$, $(0,4)$ and $(4,5)$, including all boundaries. Sloping boundaries: $y=-\frac52x+15$ and $y=\frac14x+4$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}5x+2y&\le30\\2y&\le-5x+30\\y&\le-\frac52x+15\end{aligned}$$
$$\begin{aligned}4y-x&\ge16\\4y&\ge x+16\\y&\ge\frac14x+4\end{aligned}$$
The $y$-intercepts are $(0,15)$ and $(0,4)$. At the intersection of the sloping boundaries:
$$\begin{aligned}-\frac52x+15&=\frac14x+4\\-10x+60&=x+16\\11x&=44\\x&=4\\y&=\frac14(4)+4\\y&=5\end{aligned}$$
Draw all boundaries solid. Shade to the right of the $y$-axis, above $y=\frac14x+4$ and below $y=-\frac52x+15$. The vertices are $(0,15)$, $(0,4)$ and $(4,5)$.

spec.description: Two solid sloping boundaries and the positive y-axis enclose a shaded triangle. Corrected descending-line coefficient; all three intersections labelled. No numbered ticks.

answer.short: Open triangular region with boundary intersections $(-2.5,3)$, $(2,3)$ and $(2,1.2)$. All three boundaries and their intersections are excluded.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}2x+5y&>10\\5y&>-2x+10\\y&>-\frac25x+2\end{aligned}$$
For the sloping boundary at $y=3$:
$$\begin{aligned}2x+5(3)&=10\\2x&=-5\\x&=-\frac52\end{aligned}$$
At $x=2$:
$$\begin{aligned}2(2)+5y&=10\\5y&=6\\y&=\frac65\end{aligned}$$
The other boundary intersection is $(2,3)$. Draw all three boundaries dashed. Shade to the left of $x=2$, below $y=3$ and above $y=-\frac25x+2$. Label $(-2.5,3)$, $(2,3)$ and $(2,1.2)$; these boundary intersections are excluded.

spec.description: Solid coordinate axes, three dashed inequality boundaries and a light-blue required triangle. Open markers identify excluded boundary intersections.
